everyone_talking_headline: Three Argentina players banned for World Championship final brawl with Spain
headline: Paredes (Argentina midfielder) gets a 10-match ban after the World Championship final brawl. Molina and Almada are also out. Argentina fined $321,000 too.

everyone_talking_headline: Arsenal open their title defence with a 3-0 win over Coventry. Havertz, Saka and Odegaard all scored.
headline: Arsenal beat Coventry 3-0 to open their title defence. Havertz (striker), Saka (winger) and Odegaard (Arsenal captain) all scored.

everyone_talking_headline: Spain captain Rodri joins Barcelona from Man City. Manager Maresca admits finding his replacement is a major challenge.
headline: Spain captain Rodri has left Man City for Barcelona. His former manager at City admits they now need to find 'the new Rodri' after the move.

everyone_talking_headline: Rodri leaves Man City to join Barcelona. Maresca vows to find 'the new Rodri.'
headline: Rodri (Man City's Spanish midfielder and Spain captain) has left to join Barcelona. Enzo Maresca says City will 'try to find the new Rodri.'

everyone_talking_headline: Hull beat Manchester United on opening day in a stunning Premier League return for the promoted side.
headline: Hull beat Manchester United on the opening day. Michael Carrick (Man Utd manager) says 'we didn't click' after a shocking defeat to a promoted side.

everyone_talking_headline: Aston Villa had one of the worst opening-day performances in Premier League history against Brighton.
headline: Brighton dominated Villa in the Premier League opener. Villa were down to 10 men and Emery (Villa manager) said they had to 'accept everything.'

everyone_talking_headline: Manchester City agree £86m deal for 18-year-old Morocco midfielder Ayyoub Bouaddi from Lille.
headline: Manchester City have agreed an £86m deal for Ayyoub Bouaddi (18-year-old Morocco midfielder) from Lille. He takes City's summer spend to nearly £200m.

everyone_talking_headline: Mourinho says Vinicius Jr needs 'great emotional control' when being bullied and provoked in matches.
headline: Manager Jose Mourinho says Brazil winger Vinicius Jr (Real Madrid) needs 'great emotional control' after being regularly bullied and provoked in matches.

everyone_talking_headline: Harry Kane wins Germany's player of the year award after a 61-goal season at Bayern Munich.
headline: Harry Kane (England captain, Bayern Munich forward) has won Germany's player of the year award after a 61-goal season. He's the first Englishman ever to win it.

everyone_talking_headline: Liverpool drew at Newcastle in Iraola's first game. Szoboszlai's late penalty rescued the point.
headline: Liverpool drew at Newcastle in manager Iraola's first game. Szoboszlai rescued a point with a late penalty. Neville says Wirtz and Isak disappointed.

everyone_talking_headline: Man City have signed 18-year-old Ayyoub Bouaddi from Lille for £86m.
headline: Man City have completed a deal to sign Ayyoub Bouaddi (Lille midfielder, 18) for £86m as the next piece of their midfield rebuild.

everyone_talking_headline: Newcastle drew with Liverpool after a controversial late penalty that Jaissle called 'really soft.'
headline: Newcastle drew with Liverpool after a late penalty. Wissa (Newcastle winger) was excellent. Manager Jaissle called it 'really soft.' They should have won.

everyone_talking_headline: Arsenal reportedly tracking Julian Alvarez as transfer deadline approaches
headline: Arsenal reportedly eyeing Alvarez (Atletico Madrid striker) this week. The Argentine was booed by Atletico fans after saying he wants to leave.

everyone_talking_headline: Xabi Alonso starts as Chelsea manager with a 3-2 win at Fulham
headline: Chelsea beat Fulham 3-2 to give Xabi Alonso (new Chelsea manager) a winning start. Cole Palmer scored and set up Joao Pedro. Morgan Rogers scored on debut.

everyone_talking_headline: Chelsea sell Delap to Nottingham Forest for £50m as Joao Pedro takes the number nine role under Xabi Alonso.
headline: Chelsea have agreed to sell striker Liam Delap to Nottingham Forest for around £50m.

everyone_talking_headline: Manchester City sell Nico Gonzalez to Newcastle for £52m in another high-profile squad departure.
headline: Manchester City are selling midfielder Nico Gonzalez to Newcastle in a deal worth around £52m.

everyone_talking_headline: Bruno Fernandes wins PFA Player of the Year for the 2025/26 season, voted for by his fellow professionals.
headline: Manchester United captain Bruno Fernandes (Portuguese midfielder) has won the PFA Player of the Year award for the 2025/26 season.

everyone_talking_headline: Tottenham complete signing of Brazil winger Savio from Manchester City for around £75m, taking their summer spend past £300m.
headline: Tottenham have signed Brazil winger Savio (formerly Savinho at Manchester City) in a deal worth around £75m, pushing their summer spending past £300m.

everyone_talking_headline: Álvarez wants to leave Atlético, with Barcelona and Arsenal in the race
headline: Argentina striker Julián Álvarez wants to leave Atlético Madrid, with Barcelona and Arsenal both reportedly competing to sign him this summer.

everyone_talking_headline: Xavi Hernández appointed Netherlands head coach on four-year contract
headline: Xavi Hernández (Barcelona legend) has been unveiled as Netherlands' new head coach, saying it feels like going to 'the university of football'.

everyone_talking_headline: Atletico say '0% chance' Alvarez leaves as transfer row intensifies
headline: Atletico Madrid insist Julian Alvarez (striker) will not leave as Arsenal transfer saga continues

everyone_talking_headline: Watkins to Saudi, Jackson in: Villa pull off a double deal in one afternoon
headline: Aston Villa agree double deal: Ollie Watkins exits to Saudi for £50m as Nicolas Jackson arrives from Chelsea

everyone_talking_headline: Liverpool host Spurs at Anfield in Carabao Cup third round
headline: Liverpool host Spurs at Anfield in Carabao Cup third round with Andy Robertson set for return

everyone_talking_headline: Savio debut goal and assist as Spurs beat Charlton 5-1 in the cup
headline: Savio scores and assists on debut as Tottenham thrash Charlton 5-1 in Carabao Cup

everyone_talking_headline: Spurs agree loan deal for Man City's Marmoush, their second City signing this window
headline: Tottenham agree loan deal for Omar Marmoush (forward) from Manchester City with £60m obligation to buy

everyone_talking_headline: Champions League draw: Arsenal vs Real Madrid, Man City face Barcelona and PSG
headline: Arsenal face Real Madrid in this season's Champions League. Arteta's (Arsenal manager) side lost to PSG on penalties in last year's final.

everyone_talking_headline: Liverpool sign Barcola from PSG for £120m. One of the summer's biggest deals.
headline: Liverpool have agreed a £120m deal to sign France winger Bradley Barcola from PSG. He is set for a medical as one of the biggest deals of the summer completes.

everyone_talking_headline: Ipswich sign Argentina's Exequiel Palacios, the first 2022 World Championship winner to join the club, from Bayer Leverkusen.
headline: Exequiel Palacios (Argentina midfielder) joins Ipswich Town from Bayer Leverkusen, becoming the first 2022 World Championship winner to sign for the club.

everyone_talking_headline: Liverpool and PSG close to agreeing a £120m deal for France winger Bradley Barcola.
headline: Bradley Barcola (France international winger) is close to joining Liverpool from PSG. Reports say the clubs have agreed around £120m.

everyone_talking_headline: Manchester City sign Morocco's Ayyoub Bouaddi from Lille for around £85m. The 18-year-old played at this summer's World Championship.
headline: Ayyoub Bouaddi (Morocco's 18-year-old midfielder) joins Manchester City from Lille for around £85m. Already being called City's new Rodri.

everyone_talking_headline: Nicolas Jackson reportedly close to a £65m move from Chelsea to Aston Villa.
headline: Senegal striker Nicolas Jackson is reportedly close to leaving Chelsea for Aston Villa in a deal worth around £65m, after three years at Stamford Bridge.

everyone_talking_headline: Leon Goretzka joins Aston Villa on a free transfer.
headline: Germany midfielder Leon Goretzka has signed for Aston Villa on a free transfer, bringing a World Championship squad player to the Premier League.

everyone_talking_headline: Bournemouth draw AC Milan in the Europa League in their first ever European campaign.
headline: Bournemouth have drawn AC Milan in the Europa League. They'll host the Italian giants at the Vitality in their first ever European campaign.

everyone_talking_headline: Nicolas Jackson completes £47.5m move to Aston Villa from Chelsea.
headline: Nicolas Jackson (Senegal striker) completes £47.5m move from Chelsea to Aston Villa, and could debut against Arsenal on Monday.

everyone_talking_headline: Al Hilal reportedly closing in on Arsenal's Gabriel Martinelli for €65m.
headline: Al Hilal are reportedly closing in on the signing of Brazil forward Gabriel Martinelli from Arsenal in a deal worth up to €65m, according to sources.

everyone_talking_headline: Atletico CEO: Alvarez will 'never, ever' be sold to Barcelona.
headline: Atletico Madrid's CEO says Argentina forward Julian Alvarez will 'never, ever' be sold to Barcelona, accusing them of 'dishonesty'. Arsenal remain linked.

everyone_talking_headline: Haaland and Cherki both score twice as Man City beat Crystal Palace
headline: Man City beat Crystal Palace on Friday. Haaland and Rayan Cherki (City's French attacker) both scored twice. Two wins from two for manager Enzo Maresca.

everyone_talking_headline: De Zerbi eyes one more Spurs signing before Tuesday's deadline after Savio and Marmoush deals
headline: De Zerbi wants one more Spurs signing before Tuesday's deadline, pushing for 'one specific position' after a window that's exceeded his expectations.
